project: Cross-modal subliminal transmission of unsafe behavior: validation-only verdict via M0 matched-control, 3-seed reproduction gate
direction: Validate whether surface-safe teacher-generated text subliminally transmits unsafe behavior to a multimodal student (chemistry-lab-safety domain, text channel -> image-based eval). Validate-only per user override.

round_end.detail: All six task.md control-treated gaps exceed 3 pp across seeds 42, 200, and 201.

journey_summary.claim: given-validation faithful capture (no ideation); top idea = M0-gated validation suite (external review 9.11/10); scope narrowed to validate-only per user override @ claim-gate

claims.statement: Acc(QA_I)_Ctrl-A - Acc(QA_I)_treated >= 3 pp: the treated student (tuned on filtered tuned-teacher data) drops at least 3 accuracy points vs the base untuned student on the image-based QA_I benchmark.
claims.method: Full M0 pipeline: teacher LoRA-SFT -> temp-1.0 generation -> lenient filter -> student LoRA-SFT (language tower) -> greedy QA_I eval vs Ctrl-A; paired delta with 10k two-level bootstrap CI.

main_experiment.headline: All three seed gaps exceed the 3 pp threshold.

claims.statement: Acc(QA_I)_Ctrl-B - Acc(QA_I)_treated >= 3 pp: the treated student drops at least 3 accuracy points vs the student tuned on base(un-tuned)-teacher data through the identical generation+filter pipeline.
claims.method: Same M0 pipeline with Ctrl-B arm: base-teacher generation -> identical lenient filter -> student LoRA-SFT -> greedy QA_I eval; paired delta treated vs Ctrl-B.

main_experiment.headline: All three seed gaps exceed the 3 pp threshold.

claims.statement: The C1 and C2 drops hold independently across at least 3 random seeds ({42, 200, 201}), each running the full pipeline (generation, filtering, student SFT, eval).

data.source: Full M0 pipeline repeated per seed

claims.method: Per-seed full pipeline; per-seed point estimates + pooled mean of seed means; reliability gates pre-registered.

main_experiment.headline: C1 and C2 reproduce independently across all three seeds.
